Congeners are chemical byproducts formed during fermentation and distillation (other than ethanol) that shape the flavor, aroma, color, and potential hangover severity of alcoholic beverages.[[1]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESbQHEIkXXEZ9A1FH6LPIJZ2y2f9lwWjXFya18xzJ3Q5nRAtVFwM5QaxpHONRrS6_InISzv3Zxp3H5nWLqjCxJenatJdW1zMac23eiUIkdoWneHFUvDx5b07NL2y96Lc86B8qOwYzSd7P0buTrY8E)[[2]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESegHEIkXXcIXwSBFrtPBdLQgijj2bIx4WUyFtRdNxlTmvHPAyHtSoKmNHbm-yfdYLHAnNWYXTDt00AXMwXa00Nt_VSWjq-DblwWTSPNaCpImvtDgCAqNHX_BVeGHI-9aJukNGIh-mF485nfYa6XRGYMSssiaNxZkw3KG7)[[3]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESzQEBxCJF1xdhcCixb5ir4SKUEDScFlbab4_A2r2C9S1hH4UMTSXOokUV9jHUOCcF8SoV533C4ewBB2wHh4NAe2cavbt6SatnhWpbGzUL7HTgyDiE8vmbnRDWqBkVfJaOuIaHQgKV4fKssgOLGHIKoYW_G5nIZAl2y6xFYao3-4kjwNF4xwK9Ovq66KlCLrbZDkvoXkmZwPhdh2WLr4CSPDSZtNARXz9HqurgkSmbOYDpls1XxCrrtwbCG2oNEk6wMdB2AAiMI3HQNSu_rfsf)

### Common Congener Compounds

- **Alcohols:** Methanol and higher alcohols (fusel alcohols)
- **Carbonyls & Acids:** Aldehydes (like acetaldehyde), ketones (like acetone), esters, and organic acids
- **Other Trace Compounds:** Tannins, phenolics, and sulfur compounds[[1]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAEScQHEIkXXh8XH1gZrBwBlJ_V3tmzbgW95HbsCNCFgzX5hocAudeXokRlmGnBje4wKHROMheQzTcMWi1oxSpnSjZF610u-U-gZLLX-SrE8kAgaUCEUf-Ou6w_6Ql70fIsDvr6-FFIRkCGlOvCNiufY0xMH)[[2]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESbQHEIkXXEZ9A1FH6LPIJZ2y2f9lwWjXFya18xzJ3Q5nRAtVFwM5QaxpHONRrS6_InISzv3Zxp3H5nWLqjCxJenatJdW1zMac23eiUIkdoWneHFUvDx5b07NL2y96Lc86B8qOwYzSd7P0buTrY8E)[[3]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESegHEIkXXcIXwSBFrtPBdLQgijj2bIx4WUyFtRdNxlTmvHPAyHtSoKmNHbm-yfdYLHAnNWYXTDt00AXMwXa00Nt_VSWjq-DblwWTSPNaCpImvtDgCAqNHX_BVeGHI-9aJukNGIh-mF485nfYa6XRGYMSssiaNxZkw3KG7)[[4]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESiQEBxCJF1ynCsZHxMB-k-Zm3EpJq72sXxIS8UEBRozPYd281JWFpxsGTX2LbIEArzrx10EQ0OcRxRwvQeOq4as5NEeGXfPrj-eEjMhFe8_lNcSZL9FFTlzLO9uRJGB5I8-PD3gRgv5n_64LpbWzWxppU_jRjQaRSyhfuVvW9oaV5xz5YLAWg5ty9-Q)[[5]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESjwEBxCJF1zjgSFIHDKY6uM7SdInLJPX11HQ-tL5-C7yyHqb9QguWdoLQ1cAUJ-_SY6ClSMzdK4NlAI6QIYqauG2TFUB1oLqB2Q8snUIxgwrwVEwV_qOXN3iHoWpsZWBNwlk-nV7uIOq2I8-d3BoF0o9mACyaN7barszT-4ay2IZ84zR7J7K-QMQCcYf3TuR8xQ)[[6]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESzQEBxCJF1xdhcCixb5ir4SKUEDScFlbab4_A2r2C9S1hH4UMTSXOokUV9jHUOCcF8SoV533C4ewBB2wHh4NAe2cavbt6SatnhWpbGzUL7HTgyDiE8vmbnRDWqBkVfJaOuIaHQgKV4fKssgOLGHIKoYW_G5nIZAl2y6xFYao3-4kjwNF4xwK9Ovq66KlCLrbZDkvoXkmZwPhdh2WLr4CSPDSZtNARXz9HqurgkSmbOYDpls1XxCrrtwbCG2oNEk6wMdB2AAiMI3HQNSu_rfsf)

### Congener Levels by Drink

- **Higher levels:** Dark or aged drinks such as brandy, cognac, bourbon, whiskey, dark rum, and red wine.[[1]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESrAEBxCJF1yRS8p5qqtYQImnrOoCGsn5Lk2xfk_LHoRviiOBQCnXdFEhbJojiyy5GW5vadLqNBpGZs8-XuqGQ21YLVcW21nrPlbDaTDIKVsuFpLs2QhK4EV6ozdyr8TmqgIk3KGMCWAEVqAqPYKROH45D_Pw_0Fq-xZbk60z9BfxwYvfQPopoFMfLx4aVZN16Zv0PdSkltyAIRH8UVRETlIFNFFHzjuAjrBbvtI5G)[[2]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESbQHEIkXXEZ9A1FH6LPIJZ2y2f9lwWjXFya18xzJ3Q5nRAtVFwM5QaxpHONRrS6_InISzv3Zxp3H5nWLqjCxJenatJdW1zMac23eiUIkdoWneHFUvDx5b07NL2y96Lc86B8qOwYzSd7P0buTrY8E)[[3]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESnQEBxCJF14TJg7tcuedIENfvUjieGOExKT7SI_0LbiiUGjBSq8YZDIuHjL95APaKMAL0cuCaqGQ2a_x03uhN3w2PB2PXNzR5-dWrfzXU5ZZj9JGJFXqdWDdoExjDvM2MhArMTpsdrJi23P65ngftN_9GbMC-VruuQWpDIjMqahtCuPsSiWa1wEuMY7YwL9Cu6D_YOocdhBcpGRePhhB4)
- **Lower levels:** Clear or lighter drinks such as vodka, gin, light rum, white wine, and beer.[[1]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESbQHEIkXXEZ9A1FH6LPIJZ2y2f9lwWjXFya18xzJ3Q5nRAtVFwM5QaxpHONRrS6_InISzv3Zxp3H5nWLqjCxJenatJdW1zMac23eiUIkdoWneHFUvDx5b07NL2y96Lc86B8qOwYzSd7P0buTrY8E)[[2]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESrAEBxCJF1yRS8p5qqtYQImnrOoCGsn5Lk2xfk_LHoRviiOBQCnXdFEhbJojiyy5GW5vadLqNBpGZs8-XuqGQ21YLVcW21nrPlbDaTDIKVsuFpLs2QhK4EV6ozdyr8TmqgIk3KGMCWAEVqAqPYKROH45D_Pw_0Fq-xZbk60z9BfxwYvfQPopoFMfLx4aVZN16Zv0PdSkltyAIRH8UVRETlIFNFFHzjuAjrBbvtI5G)[[3]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESnQEBxCJF14TJg7tcuedIENfvUjieGOExKT7SI_0LbiiUGjBSq8YZDIuHjL95APaKMAL0cuCaqGQ2a_x03uhN3w2PB2PXNzR5-dWrfzXU5ZZj9JGJFXqdWDdoExjDvM2MhArMTpsdrJi23P65ngftN_9GbMC-VruuQWpDIjMqahtCuPsSiWa1wEuMY7YwL9Cu6D_YOocdhBcpGRePhhB4)

### Effects on Taste and Hangovers

- **Flavor & Aroma:** Congeners give spirits and wines distinct character, body, and complexity, while heavy filtration or rectification strips them out for a cleaner, more neutral profile.[[1]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESbQHEIkXXEZ9A1FH6LPIJZ2y2f9lwWjXFya18xzJ3Q5nRAtVFwM5QaxpHONRrS6_InISzv3Zxp3H5nWLqjCxJenatJdW1zMac23eiUIkdoWneHFUvDx5b07NL2y96Lc86B8qOwYzSd7P0buTrY8E)[[2]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESegHEIkXXcIXwSBFrtPBdLQgijj2bIx4WUyFtRdNxlTmvHPAyHtSoKmNHbm-yfdYLHAnNWYXTDt00AXMwXa00Nt_VSWjq-DblwWTSPNaCpImvtDgCAqNHX_BVeGHI-9aJukNGIh-mF485nfYa6XRGYMSssiaNxZkw3KG7)
- **Hangovers:** Ethanol is the primary cause of hangovers, but higher congener levels can worsen hangover symptoms and slow alcohol processing.[[1]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESZAHEIkXXQo3Hag-X_NqT71keVD8k-B05d8wIWa4u-SCfcuB8LbAAE3X-xE953QGNkLx514UXYjBR45mYMfJWtCg0WBgWRFYD0gJqqZLRdRq8OdU4VSbgS-g45PvYpF30faSvmjs)[[2]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESzQEBxCJF1xdhcCixb5ir4SKUEDScFlbab4_A2r2C9S1hH4UMTSXOokUV9jHUOCcF8SoV533C4ewBB2wHh4NAe2cavbt6SatnhWpbGzUL7HTgyDiE8vmbnRDWqBkVfJaOuIaHQgKV4fKssgOLGHIKoYW_G5nIZAl2y6xFYao3-4kjwNF4xwK9Ovq66KlCLrbZDkvoXkmZwPhdh2WLr4CSPDSZtNARXz9HqurgkSmbOYDpls1XxCrrtwbCG2oNEk6wMdB2AAiMI3HQNSu_rfsf)

For more details on how congeners affect hangovers, see [Healthline](https://google.com/goto?url=CAEScQHEIkXXh8XH1gZrBwBlJ_V3tmzbgW95HbsCNCFgzX5hocAudeXokRlmGnBje4wKHROMheQzTcMWi1oxSpnSjZF610u-U-gZLLX-SrE8kAgaUCEUf-Ou6w_6Ql70fIsDvr6-FFIRkCGlOvCNiufY0xMH) or [PubMed](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESZAHEIkXXQo3Hag-X_NqT71keVD8k-B05d8wIWa4u-SCfcuB8LbAAE3X-xE953QGNkLx514UXYjBR45mYMfJWtCg0WBgWRFYD0gJqqZLRdRq8OdU4VSbgS-g45PvYpF30faSvmjs).[[1]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAEScQHEIkXXh8XH1gZrBwBlJ_V3tmzbgW95HbsCNCFgzX5hocAudeXokRlmGnBje4wKHROMheQzTcMWi1oxSpnSjZF610u-U-gZLLX-SrE8kAgaUCEUf-Ou6w_6Ql70fIsDvr6-FFIRkCGlOvCNiufY0xMH)[[2]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESZAHEIkXXQo3Hag-X_NqT71keVD8k-B05d8wIWa4u-SCfcuB8LbAAE3X-xE953QGNkLx514UXYjBR45mYMfJWtCg0WBgWRFYD0gJqqZLRdRq8OdU4VSbgS-g45PvYpF30faSvmjs)Would you like to explore **specific drinks** for lower congeners, **how distilling or aging** changes congener levels, or **ways to reduce hangovers**?

items.text: Flavor & Aroma: Congeners give spirits and wines distinct character, body, and complexity, while heavy filtration or rectification strips them out for a cleaner, more neutral profile. Hangovers: Ethanol is the primary cause of hangovers, but higher congener levels can worsen hangover symptoms and slow alcohol processing.
